```{r, setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(magrittr)
library(driveanalytics)

knitr::opts_knit$set(echo = FALSE)

# Get the render format
render_format <- knitr::opts_knit$get('rmarkdown.pandoc.to')
if (render_format == "") render_format <- "html"
```

## Overview
This method calculates the frequency an event happened. It takes in a column of interest and will return the distance between events as days between each event.

The analysis produces two outputs.

1. A table of summary statistics (mean, median, range, and total events)
2. A box plot of the time between events.

## Method
The method goes through the column and for each event it identifies the previous time this occurred and calculates the time between these events as days between.

## Considerations and Limitations
* It assumes events have the same name. It will not link events where there is a small variation, e.g. a different mdeication dose.

## Example
The following recurrence analysis plot, summary and results table are from a randomly generated set of 10 patients with 100 events in total.


This recurrence analysis example shows the following information:

1. A box plot of the time between events for *Event J*.
2. Summary stats for all events.
3. The complete dataframe of all events with time between events calculated where applicable.

```{r, example, echo=FALSE, dpi=200, out.width="100%", fig.dim = c(8, 3)}

# Create a random sample of patients in two cohorts and assign random events
set.seed(123)
n <- 100
n_events <- 10
df_events <- tibble::tibble(
  project_id = sample(10, size = n, replace = TRUE),
  cohort_id = project_id,
  cohort = sample(c("A","B"), n, replace = TRUE),
)
df_events$event <- sample(paste0("Event ", LETTERS[1:n_events]), n, replace = TRUE)
df_events$start_datetime <- sample(
  seq(as.Date("2010-01-01"), as.Date("2020-10-01"), by = "month"),
  size = n,
  replace = TRUE
)

# Perform recurrence analysis and get results
gra <- driveanalytics::gen_recurrence_analysis(df_events, "event", "cohort")
plot(gra, "Event J", TRUE)
# sessionInfo()
summary <- driveanalytics::tabulate(gra)
print(gra)
print(summary)
```
